name: Features
summary: Eleven features sections for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Features), in the layouts of the Untitled UI features sections the marketing team picked: alternating rows, an icon grid, an icon list with a photo, icon cards, a single row of three Feature cards, icons around a phone or a results screenshot, and tabs with screenshots. Framework-free HTML and CSS, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens and built from values the Hero, Cards, Hero banner, FAQ and Footer banner sections already ship. Every picture is a neutral image slot to swap for a real image. Each section has two backgrounds, White (the default) and Accent (add the class aha-features--accent).
highlights: Eleven layouts on one page, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet

Two backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-features--accent to the section; the icon squares turn white on Accent so they stay visible, and the Feature cards stay white with their pink icon tile

Layout copied from Untitled UI; every colour, size, space, radius and font is an --aha-* token, and the eyebrow, title and lead carry the Hero section's values verbatim, and the buttons are <aha-button size="xl">

Every picture is an image slot (4:3 or portrait 3:4, the Cards and Hero banner ratios) with a neutral placeholder to swap for a real image; no third-party photo or device image, and no product recreated in HTML
Icon squares are the DS Feature card icon; the Learn more link is the Feature card link
Icon cards reuse the DS Feature card from the Cards page unchanged; this page adds only the grid around it
Feature card row is one header above a single horizontal row of three DS Feature cards, stacking to one column at 767 px; for a row of four, use Icon cards
Icons are registry glyphs called by name with <aha-icon>
Tabs with screenshots ships working WAI-ARIA tabs (arrow keys, Home, End) in a short framework-free script; the structure maps onto Webflow's native Tabs element
Each section is a container-query block: it steps down at 991 px and 767 px and tightens again below 480 px, wherever it sits

A landscape or square image, alone or among others of the same size, fills its slot edge to edge at their own ratio (aha-features__photo--fill): no frame, no inset, no crop. A portrait image (taller than wide) is always framed, even alone or when every image is the same size, and so is any section with more than one image whose sizes or ratios differ: they sit uncropped in a Vivid Pink frame (aha-features__photo--pink-frame): the centre Splash from the Background library behind the picture, an even inset, one 4:3 frame ratio per section. Photos exported at the slot's ratio keep object-fit cover

layouts.name: Alternating with screenshots
layouts.summary: A centred header, then three rows that swap sides: icon, title, text and two buttons beside a screenshot. All the screenshots are the same size, so each fills its slot edge to edge at its own ratio (aha-features__photo--fill), with no frame and no crop; swap the placeholder for a real product screenshot.

guidance.title: Choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every layout below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-features--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. The icon squares switch to white and keep their pink glyph; cards stay white with their pink icon tile, and image placeholders stay grey.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.

points.title: Fill the slot, or frame mixed sizes
points.text: Never crop a screenshot. When the section holds one landscape or square image, or several of the same size, add aha-features__photo--fill to the photo slot: the image fills the slot edge to edge at its own ratio, with no frame and no inset. When an image is portrait (taller than wide), or the section holds more than one image and the images differ in size or ratio, add aha-features__photo--pink-frame to the photo slot, put the Splash icon in an aha-features__splash element behind it and give the picture the class aha-features__shot: each image is contained with an even inset on Vivid Pink (--aha-vivid-pink-100) with the centre Splash, and the frame keeps one ratio (4:3) for every row of the section.
